subject: aftf
title: (R)AFTF.------TH.CONT.
description: Chart on book p. 215 (CMOA(I)-9). AFTF (affinity transfer) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; TH-CONT (thrust continuance) is the partner. From TH-CONT: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From T-C-IMP: CRTF-D (cross-transfer definitions) and TF-SH (transfer shifts). POL-SIGN (political significance) is on a dotted line from T-C-IMP.
